scope: Convert the H1c-1b.2 fixed-family cumulative psi bound into Maynard Proposition 9.2's exact half-open unweighted prime-count discrepancy for the actual identity form. Preserve the Abel integral sign, prime powers, endpoint atoms, and the exact total population. Do not perform density normalization, full remainder absorption, or threshold calculation.

literature_search.principle: Search a published explicit psi-to-pi bridge before proving a project-specific transfer, then compare interval, modulus family, center, endpoint, and error term individually.
searched_sources: Akbary-Hambrook 2015 Theorem 1.3, Corollary 1.4, and its proof
FGKMT 2018 Theorem 6 and Section 8 identity-form call
Bordignon 2021 final Theorem 1.4 and fixed-Q1 exceptional-modulus quantifier
literature_search.limitation: The targeted search is not a worldwide nonexistence or novelty claim. The apparent minus sign in the Akbary-Hambrook displayed partial-summation identity is not copied; the project uses the directly derived plus sign. Their subsequent triangle bound is insensitive to this sign.

actual_target.analytic_scale: T=x/2 in the FGKMT Section 8 call
actual_target.local_count: P_T(q,a)=#{p:T<=p<2T and p congruent to a mod q}

uniform_fixed_family.fixed_inputs: A=100r^2+10, Q1=(log T)^A, and the H1c-1b.2 B selected at the fixed outer scale
uniform_fixed_family.reason: log(T)>2A makes sqrt(u)/(log u)^A increasing on [T,2T]; Q1<=(log u)^A also persists; q<=T^(1/3) is already inside the lower-endpoint capacity

abel_partial_summation.auxiliary_count: pi_1(y;q,a)=sum_{2<=n<=y,n=a mod q} Lambda(n)/log(n)=sum_{p^k<=y,p^k=a mod q}1/k
abel_partial_summation.source_display_caution: Akbary-Hambrook p. 26 visibly prints a minus sign inside the cumulative absolute-value display; direct Stieltjes/Abel summation gives plus. The source's following triangle inequality is unchanged by this sign.

half_open_endpoint.count_identity: P_[T,2T)=P_(T,2T]+1_P(T)-1_P(2T), with the same identity in each residue class
half_open_endpoint.one_atom_reason: For T>2, if T is an integer prime then 2T is composite; if 2T is an odd prime then T is not an integer.

final_parameterized_bound.exact_center: The center is P_T/phi(q), where P_T=#{p:T<=p<2T}; no T/log(T) approximation is introduced in H1c-1b.3.

next_gate.description: Resolve the Bordignon C(A,A-3,X0/Y0) normalization, obtain an explicit lower bound for the exact represented-prime population, and absorb the twelve remainder terms plus H1c-1b.3 transfer costs into the required (log T)^(-100r^2) rate with one common cutoff.
